title: Filipino culinary heritage promoted in Nat'l Food Showdown in Ilocos

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Regional cuisines, indigenous ingredients, and traditional food practices took center stage as nearly 300 students from Northern Luzon gathered in Laoag City, Ilocos Norte, for the 17th National Food Showdown, which promotes and preserves Filipino culinary heritage. Held on Nov. 20 and 21 at the Ilocos Norte Centennial Arena in Laoag City, the competition brought together students from nearly 40 higher education institutions in Regions 1 and 2 and the Cordillera Administrative Region.
